pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(gentle solo piano, sparse and warm)

[Verse 1]
Staying until your time.
I notice staying until your time before the room does.
I say Remaining once, then let the notes finish.

[Pre-Chorus]
I walk the length of Remaining and stop.
Nothing in Remaining argues with the quiet.

[Chorus]
Remaining is only the name I give this hour.
A window holds Remaining a little longer.
Remaining begins when the first line does.

[Verse 2]
What I can point to is staying until your time.
Staying until your time.

[Piano Solo]
(expressive melodic piano solo, sustained and tender)

[Bridge]
I say Remaining once, then let the notes finish.
I walk the length of Remaining and stop.

[Chorus]
Remaining is only the name I give this hour.
A window holds Remaining a little longer.
Remaining begins when the first line does.

[Outro]
(solo piano fades into soft residual notes)
I notice staying until your time before the room does.
